simcal_simulate — SIMCAL model op

• データ種: simmodel → images

• 呼び出し: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.simcal_simulate(model=None, theta=None, seed=None) -> 'list' (実装を直接呼ぶなら import simcal; simcal.simcal_simulate(model=None, theta=None, seed=None) -> 'list'、台帳から引くなら opssimcal.get("simcal_simulate"))

使い方

つまみの値で simmodel の連鎖を走らせる -> 条件ごとに 2-D 配列 1 枚(images)。

> 以下の詳細説明は原文のままです —— 要約と見出しは訳出済み。

theta is {knob: value} in natural units (missing knobs take their initial or fixed value; a calresult is accepted and its theta_hat used). Values outside a knob's range are allowed here (a simulation is not a fit). seed overrides the common-random- number seed of a stochastic model (None = the model's own). Refuses an unknown knob name or a non-finite output.
